records.medium: SHADOW THEATRE / layered silhouette animation still. Flat cut BLACK paper silhouettes of corridor, doors, foreground framing and threatening shadow against translucent smoky sepia/amber backlit paper. Depth comes from 4 overlapping flat planes and diminishing cutout apertures; absolutely no realistic photographic floor texture, no brush-painted surface, no 3D game render. Entire image an expressive handmade silhouette stage, oppressive and uncanny.
